dogecoin.text: Friendly reminder.  Around 14,400,400 new Dogecoin ($DOGE) tokens are created each day, while 3600 Litecoin ($LTC) are generated per day.  Doge has no max supply. Litecoin has a max supply of 84 million.  Every 6 days the amount of new DOGE equals the total Litecoin supply.
